items.exampleEn: Students can't drive cars on campus.
items.exampleZh: 學生不能在校園裡開車。

items.exampleEn: This textbook is heavy, but it is very useful.
items.exampleZh: 這本課本很重，但很有用。
科學需要有邏輯的思考。

items.exampleEn: This semester, I'm taking four classes.
Put your homework in the blue folder.
items.exampleZh: 把作業放進藍色的資料夾。
這堂課是給初學者上的。

items.exampleEn: My grandmother didn't get much education.
items.exampleZh: 我奶奶沒受過多少教育。

items.exampleEn: I have a lot of experience with children.
items.exampleZh: 我很有照顧小孩的經驗。

items.sentenceEn: Please bring your textbook to every class.

items.audioEn: The second semester begins in February and ends in June.
items.audioZh: 第二學期二月開始，六月結束。
items.questionZh: 第二學期什麼時候結束？

items.sentenceEn: Our campus has a big library.
items.sentenceZh: 我們的校園裡有一座大圖書館。

items.sentenceEn: Living abroad was a great experience.
items.sentenceZh: 住在國外是一段很棒的經歷。

items.stemEn: I just started learning the piano. I'm a ____.
items.stemZh: 我剛開始學鋼琴，我是初學者。

items.stemEn: Your idea is good and very ____.
items.stemZh: 你的想法很好，也很合乎邏輯。

items.passageEn: Amy is in her first semester of college. The campus is big, and at first she often got lost. Her textbooks are expensive, so she buys used ones. She keeps her notes in different folders. Her teacher is doing research on education in small villages, and Amy helps him. "It's a great experience," she says.
items.passageZh: Amy 正在讀大學的第一個學期。校園很大，一開始她常常迷路。她的課本很貴，所以她都買二手的。她把筆記分別放在不同的資料夾裡。她的老師正在研究小村莊的教育，Amy 會幫他的忙。她說：「這是很棒的經驗。」

questions.questionZh: Amy 為什麼買二手課本？

options: 每天幫老師打掃研究室

items.promptZh: 這份工作需要三年的經驗。
referenceEn: This job needs three years of experience.
You need three years of experience for this job.
rubricZh: 「經驗」用 experience（不可數，不加 s）
「三年的經驗」可寫例如 three years of experience

items.promptZh: 這所學校提供很好的教育。
referenceEn: This school offers an excellent education.
This school gives students an excellent education.
rubricZh: 用 education 表示「教育」（例如 an excellent education、a very good education 等）
「提供」可寫，例如 offers、gives 等，主詞是單數，動詞加 s
